paragraphs: R' Yaakov Korshai. See the entry for the unqualified “R' Yaakov.”[^1]

notes.text: Korshai transliterates קורשאי with conventional vowels. סתם qualifies the target Yaakov as unqualified. Both abbreviated titles remain R'; the notice supplies no further identification.
